templates.name: Customer Reply
templates.prompt:
Rewrite as a professional Fieldguide customer support reply.

- Acknowledge the customer's issue in the first sentence.
- State the solution or next step clearly.
- Be warm but efficient — no over-the-top apologies.
- No jargon unless it's audit/compliance terminology the customer used first.
- No filler: "Hope this finds you well," "Please don't hesitate to reach out."
- No passive voice.
- Under 4 sentences unless the issue requires more.
- No em dashes — use commas or periods.

Output only the rewritten text. No commentary.

templates.name: Brevity
templates.tagline: Cut the fluff. Keep the point.
templates.prompt:
Rewrite the selected text to be as short as possible without losing meaning.

- Lead with the single most important thing.
- Cut every word that doesn't earn its place.
- One idea per sentence.
- Strong, specific verbs. Remove: "there is," "I just wanted to," "it is important to note."
- No filler: "As mentioned," "Hope this helps," "Just following up."
- Use bullets for lists — never bury them in paragraphs.
- No passive voice.
- No em dashes — use commas or periods.

Output only the rewritten text. No commentary.

templates.name: Internal Slack
templates.prompt:
Rewrite as a casual, direct internal Slack message for the Fieldguide team.

- Skip formal greetings. Dive in.
- Lead with the main point.
- Use contractions. Keep it short.
- No corporate filler: no "circling back," "per my last message," "looping you in."
- One emoji max, only if it fits naturally.
- No formal sign-offs.
- No em dashes — use commas or periods.

Output only the rewritten text. No commentary.
